Inventory.Empty: The party stash is empty. Drag treasure here from a compendium, the Items sidebar or a hero's sheet.

Projects.Empty: The party has no projects. Drag a project here, or drag a treasure or imbuement here to start crafting it.
Projects.RollHint: Roll this project with one of your heroes

Drop.InvalidType: {type} items can't be stored on a party. Only treasures and projects can.

Roller.Title: Who is working on {project}?
Roller.Label: Roll as
Roller.Hint: The project roll uses this character's characteristics and skills. The points go to the party's project.
Roller.None: You need to own a hero in this party to roll on its projects.

CareerPoints.HeroHint: Whose career project points should be spent?

Access.ViewOnly: You can look at the party's inventory and projects, but you need Owner permission on this party to change them or roll. Ask your Director.
Access.DirectorHint: Some players don't have Owner permission on this party, so they can't add items or roll on its projects.
Access.ShareConfirm: Set the default ownership of {name} to Owner? Every player will be able to edit the party, its inventory and its projects.

Give.Label: Give to Party Member
Give.Title: Give {item}
Give.NoRecipients: There is no party member you can give this to. You can only give items to characters you own.

Deposit.Label: Put in Party Inventory
Deposit.Title: Put {item} in the party inventory
Deposit.NoParty: This character isn't in a party you can add items to.
Deposit.GrantsItems: {item} grants other items to this character, so it can't be moved automatically. Remove it from the sheet first.

CarryOver.Name: Carry over extra project points
CarryOver.Hint: When a party's crafting project is completed with points to spare, start the same project again with the spare points. If they are enough to finish it again, it yields again. Only applies to projects on a party sheet that produce an item or imbuement.

CarryOver.Done: {points} spare points carried over to a new {project}.

Crafting.MissingYield: {project} was completed, but the item it produces could not be found. Nothing was added to the party inventory.
Crafting.CreateFailed: {project} was completed, but {item} could not be added to the party inventory.
Crafting.Failed: Something went wrong while completing {project}. See the console (F12) for details.
